propositions: The repository contains residual prose and code using the deprecated 'Success Criteria' vocabulary that must be migrated to 'Acceptance Criteria' or preserved via allowlist.

A deterministic count-pinned guard script must scan the repository to prevent reintroduction of deprecated 'Success Criteria' heading and enforce scoped bare-token rules with exact phrase inventories.

Four permanent semantic carve-outs (T2 experiment wording, definition-of-done concept, captured Jira fixtures, and migration/test probes) must be allowlisted with non-vacuous counts and remain byte-stable.
The guard must fail on unallowlisted phrase matches, count drift in either direction, malformed or duplicate allowlist entries, stale entries, and bare tokens outside designated scoped paths.
Three live-prose files (completion.py, test_completion_verifier.py, sample-ticket-log.jsonl) must be migrated from Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria wording.
The guard must be wired into the root Makefile lint target so local and CI checks enforce the same vocabulary policy.
